senses.zh_definition: Gabbar，专名，可用于人物或角色名称；一个有据可查的指称是电影《Sholay》中的角色 Gabbar Singh，但输入不足以确定是否指该角色。
senses.en_definition: A proper name, notably occurring in the character name Gabbar Singh in Sholay; the packet does not identify its intended referent.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang antaranya digunakan dalam nama watak Gabbar Singh dalam filem Sholay; rujukan yang dimaksudkan dalam paket tidak dinyatakan.
senses.nuances: 不能把该形式擅自解释为马来语的“强盗”“恶霸”或其他普通名词。输入没有 DBP 释义，故不能标为 official；本条马来文为编辑说明。排名沿用输入，下列为专名组合示例，未验证其语料频率。角色指称来源：[BFI：Sholay](https://whatson.bfi.org.uk/lff/Online/default.asp?BOparam%3A%3AWScontent%3A%3AloadArticle%3A%3Apermalink=sholay-directors-cut-lff25)。

etymology.historical_story: Gabbar has a recognizable cinematic association through Gabbar Singh, the feared antagonist discussed in the British Film Institute's account of Sholay. That association explains one cultural use of the name, rather than its linguistic origin. The packet supplies no original script, source language or contextual citation, so a deeper etymology and the intended referent remain unresolved. Source: [BFI](https://whatson.bfi.org.uk/lff/Online/default.asp?BOparam%3A%3AWScontent%3A%3AloadArticle%3A%3Apermalink=sholay-directors-cut-lff25).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Gabbar，联想电影角色 Gabbar Singh 的姓名牌；记住这是专名关联，不是“恶霸”的马来语翻译。
